title: Waiting
setting: a park: a chair on the left and a tree on the right, both in the back layer.
shots: A blue stick figure sits on the chair, facing the front, and sighs.
A red stick figure walks in happily from the right towards the chair.
The blue figure looks at the red figure, stands up and waves.
They both turn to face the camera and wave together.
camera: show the whole park, then slowly zoom in during the final wave.
